mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_sighting (work_id, layer, source_id) VALUES (#{workId}, #{layer}, #{sourceId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT x.country, x.layer, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.is_first)::bigint AS first_found, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.is_only)::bigint AS only_found FROM ( SELECT s.country, ws.layer, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_sighting o WHERE o.work_id = ws.work_id AND (o.first_seen < ws.first_seen OR (o.first_seen = ws.first_seen AND o.layer < ws.layer))) AS is_first, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM work_sighting o WHERE o.work_id = ws.work_id AND o.layer <> ws.layer) AS is_only FROM work_sighting ws JOIN work w ON w.id = ws.work_id LEFT JOIN source s ON s.id = w.source_id WHERE ws.layer IN #{l} AND ws.first_seen > now() - interval '28 days' ) x GROUP BY x.country, x.layer
